hooks.command: mkdir -p /tmp/scramjet-hook-subagents; cat >> /tmp/scramjet-hook-subagents/log.jsonl; echo >> /tmp/scramjet-hook-subagents/log.jsonl; echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "SubagentStart", "additionalContext": "Run the tests before you answer."}}'

mkdir -p /tmp/scramjet-hook-subagents; input=$(cat); echo "$input" >> /tmp/scramjet-hook-subagents/log.jsonl; case $input in *'"stop_hook_active":false'*) echo 'Say whether the tests passed.' >&2; exit 2;; esac
mkdir -p /tmp/scramjet-hook-subagents; cat >> /tmp/scramjet-hook-subagents/log.jsonl; echo >> /tmp/scramjet-hook-subagents/log.jsonl; echo 'Summary saved for the notes.'
